Subject: Clearwell launch lane: VPC/on-prem readiness & account setup

Hi James —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the minimal launch-lane prerequisites so we can spin up a Private deployment (VPC + on-prem connector) with predictable latency and auditability. If you can confirm the items below (or share a point-of-contact for each), we’ll lock the intake and schedule the network deep-dive with our infra team.

Core prerequisites (high-level) — please confirm or indicate responsible owner and ETA: 
- Account admin & billing contact (name + email)
- CIDR ranges we should expect for inbound peering and allowed egress
- Preferred KMS / HSM vendor + KMS key ARN for data-at-rest (if using customer-managed keys)
- Any corporate proxy / TLS inspection on egress (yes/no) and outbound allowlist process
- Firewall rules / ports open for gRPC/443 to our dedicated relay (we’ll provide IP ranges)
- Service account / principal we should provision for the Private control plane (IAM role names)
- TLS certs for any mutual-TLS requirements (SNI details if applicable)
- Compliance evidence owner for audit logs / retention (SOC2 needs)

Deliverables we’ll attach: a mutual action plan (spreadsheet) and an environment validation template so your engineers can tick off readiness items. I’ve attached both to this thread.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm the owners above in reply (or mark ‘TBD’).
2) We’ll schedule a 60-minute network intake call next week (we prefer mornings PT).
3) Ben (cc’d) will follow up with a day-zero runbook and a short smoke test plan.

Attachments: clearwell-mutual-action-plan.xlsx, env-validation-template.md

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
